question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: No one knows **where is he hiding.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**where he is hiding**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The correct construction of the sentence is "**where he is hiding**" because the verb "**is hiding**" correctly follows the subject "**he**."
 
• The phrase "**where is he hiding**" is incorrect because it uses an unnecessary inversion, which is only used in questions, not in statements.
 
• **Options 1, 2,** and **4** are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"No one knows **where he is hiding**__."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "where is he hide"** is incorrect because "hide" is not in the correct tense or form.
 
• **Option 2: "where he is hiding at"** is incorrect because "at" is redundant and unnecessary in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "where he has hidden is"** is incorrect because it creates an awkward and ungrammatical sentence structure.
